query:
SELECT 
  id,
  organization_id,
  balance,
  period_allowance,
  period_used,
  total_purchased,
  total_used,
  updated_at
FROM ai_credit_balance
WHERE organization_id = 120001
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  id,
  organization_id,
  type,
  amount,
  balance_after,
  task_type,
  description,
  user_id,
  created_at
FROM ai_credit_transactions
WHERE organization_id = 120001
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
